R024_recurrence_stop_and_diagnose.rule: When the same error string appears in /tmp/godot_run.log or /tmp/patch_error_history.json for the second or subsequent time, the LLM MUST stop proposing fixes and emit exactly: 'R024: this error has occurred N times. ONE diagnostic command follows. No fix.' Then give exactly one command whose output distinguishes the candidate root causes. The log_analyzer.py R024 TRIGGERED block is the mechanical enforcement. If R024 TRIGGERED appears in log_analyzer output, the next response must be a diagnostic only.
